test_title: PYST 198: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 25th Nov, 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pens are pencils.

Some markers are pencils.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are markers.

II. Some pens are markers.
solution:

Conclusions:

I. All pens are markers → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

II. Some pens are markers → False (it is possible but definite as shown in the diagram above) 

Hence, **none of the conclusions follow.**
